skill.name: docs-review
skill.description: Review Metabase documentation changes for writing style, clarity, formatting, and GitHub review comment structure.
skill.summary: Reviews Metabase documentation changes against the project writing style guide.
skill.author: metabase

security_audit.summary: The shell backtick and system reconnaissance static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, examples, and GitHub review wording. The parent-directory include is confirmed because it references content outside the skill package, and Bash permission is a separate least-privilege concern. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Package the style guide inside the skill directory or reference a reviewed marketplace resource without ../ traversal.
Remove Bash from allowed-tools unless a documented command is required, or restrict usage to specific read-only commands.

content.value_statement: Documentation reviews can miss style, clarity, and GitHub comment formatting issues. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through a Metabase-specific review workflow.
actual_capabilities: Applies Metabase writing style checks to Markdown documentation changes.
Flags tone, structure, link text, formatting, examples, and screenshot issues.
Formats local review feedback as sequentially numbered issues.
Uses GitHub pending review tools when they are available.
Provides concise suggested fixes for each documentation issue.
limitations: It depends on the referenced shared Metabase style guide being available.
It does not verify live product behavior or screenshots unless context is provided.
It focuses on documentation quality, not application code correctness or security.
It needs accurate diff line numbers before posting GitHub review comments.

use_cases.title: Review Documentation Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Check changed Markdown files for Metabase style issues before maintainers merge a pull request.

use_cases.title: Prepare Writer Feedback
use_cases.description: Generate concise, numbered feedback that helps authors revise tone, headings, examples, and link text.

use_cases.title: Check Draft Docs Locally
use_cases.description: Run a focused local review when GitHub review tools are not available or comments are not needed.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Markdown File
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this documentation file against the Metabase style guide. List only issues that materially improve reader understanding.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Pull Request Diff
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the attached pull request diff for Metabase documentation style issues. Number every issue sequentially and include concise fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare GitHub Review Comments
prompt_templates.prompt: Use PR review mode for this documentation change. Add one numbered comment per issue, then submit a non-blocking comment review with no summary body.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Related Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these related documentation files for consistent tone, headings, links, examples, and formatting. Prioritize high-impact issues first.

output_examples.input: A setup guide uses formal wording and links the word here instead of descriptive text.
output: Issue 1: Formal tone. Replace formal wording with direct language that matches the Metabase style guide.
Issue 2: Vague link text. Replace here with text that explains the destination.

output_examples.input: A pull request changes a troubleshooting page and includes long paragraphs before the action steps.
output: Issue 1: Lead with the action. Move the required step before the explanation so readers can act faster.
Issue 2: Dense paragraph. Split the paragraph into focused steps with one clear purpose each.

output_examples.input: A draft article includes inconsistent list formatting and a screenshot that shows the full browser window.
output: Issue 1: Inconsistent list format. Use one list style throughout this section.
Issue 2: Oversized screenshot. Crop the image to the relevant interface area.

best_practices: Provide the diff or changed files with line numbers when possible.
Include product context for features or screenshots that reviewers cannot inspect.
Ask for high-impact issues only when the review should stay concise.
anti_patterns: Do not use it as a general code security review.
Do not ask it to invent line numbers for missing diffs.
Do not post duplicate comments after a GitHub pending review has been submitted.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews Metabase documentation changes for writing style, clarity, formatting, links, examples, and review comment structure.

faq.question: Can it post comments on GitHub pull requests?
faq.answer: Yes, when GitHub MCP review tools are available, it can use a pending review workflow for numbered comments.

faq.question: Does it replace a human documentation review?
faq.answer: No. It helps find style and clarity issues, but a human should validate product accuracy and priorities.

faq.question: Can it review non-Metabase documentation?
faq.answer: It can provide general feedback, but its checklist and style expectations are tailored to Metabase documentation.

faq.question: Does it run tests or verify commands?
faq.answer: No. It flags examples that appear problematic, but it does not guarantee commands or screenshots are correct.

faq.question: What input works best?
faq.answer: A pull request diff, Markdown file, or focused documentation excerpt with line numbers gives the best results.
